The '''1732 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 16th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[Dahe]] across [[Massir]], and was won by [[Lycroa]], who defeated [[Emara]] 2-2 (pens) in the final.

The 1732 edition was the first FLLA World Cup held in [[Massir]], hosted by [[Dahe]], and the second contested by twenty-four teams following the format's reintroduction by the FLLA Council in 1730. The final at the principal Dahen national stadium ended level at 2-2 after extra time and was settled by a penalty shoot-out, the second in the competition's history; [[Lycroa]] prevailed and lifted the trophy for the fourth time.
